findings.passage: "A student ID gives very little information about the voter, only their name, university and a photo," Culp said. "This bill would treat college students the same as other voters, ensuring they have a government-issued ID to vote, such as a drivers license."
findings.note: Quote in a House caucus press release issued in his name. He explains Senate Bill 10, which removes student IDs as accepted ID at the polls.

He was the House sponsor of SB 10. Per the release, it removes student IDs as authorized proof of identification at the polls, requires county voter registration offices to keep updated voter lists, and requires local health officers to share death records with them every quarter.
